name: suelo-v1
idea_origin: Suelo line, 28 Oct: replica floor study (scripts/suelo/floor.py) and HALLAZGOS B30, C38, C40
hypothesis: v4 sinks about one game in nine, almost always by staying at the entry level after two reviews or by a second blow-up. Four rules measured in the replica raise the floor without lowering the mean: (1) a stalled start puts hidden risk first until promoted, so the third review arrives with the HR remark friendly (B30 rescue); (2) when every option is risky the size of the risk decides, not the growth; (3) after a blow-up the HR remark is read one step worse; (4) fewer calls to check_latest_logs and shorter notes, against the continuation limit.
predicted_behaviour: Same choices as v4-c5 in ordinary months; in L1 after two missed reviews, only risk-lowering stories and Defuse plus Lay low in the quarter; in all-risky stories, the mildest option; after a blow-up, Defuse with a friendly remark. Fewer trust crises and dismissals in official games; no fall in the mean of completed games.
refutation: Trust crises or dismissals as frequent as with v4 in official games, or a lower mean of completed games, or DeepSeek not applying the stalled-start and all-risky rules on the trap bank.
